title: macOS Terminal Power Tips
description: macOS-specific terminal commands — pbcopy, open, defaults, diskutil, and hidden tricks.

entries.label: Copy to Clipboard
entries.description: Pipe any output directly to the system clipboard

entries.label: Paste from Clipboard
entries.description: Output the current clipboard content to stdout

entries.label: Open File in Default App
entries.description: Open any file with its default application (like double-clicking)

entries.label: Open Current Dir in Finder
entries.description: Open the current terminal directory in Finder

entries.label: Open URL in Browser
entries.description: Open a URL in the default web browser from terminal

entries.label: Show/Hide Hidden Files
entries.command: defaults write com.apple.finder AppleShowAllFiles -bool true && killall Finder
entries.description: Toggle visibility of hidden files in Finder (change true to false to hide)

entries.label: Flush DNS Cache
entries.description: Clear the DNS resolver cache when having DNS issues

entries.label: Prevent Sleep
entries.description: Prevent Mac from sleeping for 1 hour (3600 seconds)

entries.label: Say Text Aloud
entries.description: Use text-to-speech to read text aloud — great for long build notifications

entries.label: Quick Look from Terminal
entries.description: Preview any file using Quick Look without opening its app

entries.label: List Listening Ports
entries.description: Show all processes listening on TCP ports (find what's using port 3000)

entries.label: Kill Process on Port
entries.description: Force kill whatever process is occupying a specific port
